scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --dir frontend dev" "cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn app.app:app --reload"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd backend && uv run ruff check . --fix
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
